files.notes: Loaded in full (no Seoul filter) into transit.subway_stations, because lines cross the city limit and clipping would break the geometry. Three coordinate errors found and NOT corrected, each surfaced by a different instrument. (1) 경의중앙선 1204 양원역 carries a coordinate ~190 km from its own 도로명주소 (address 서울시 중랑구 송림길 147, coordinate 36.964/129.091 in 경상북도); a same-named station exists on another line. Found because max_gap_m spiked; a per-시도 coordinate-median sweep confirms this is the only cross-province case. (2) 5호선 마곡(0514) sits 7.1 m from 발산(0515); found because ST_IsSimple is false, and swapping the two coordinates restores simplicity, which confirms the cause. (3) 4호선 이촌(0430) sits 14.3 m from 신용산(0429); ST_IsSimple is true here, so it was only caught by a nearest-neighbour ordering check. In all three the 도로명주소 and the coordinate contradict each other, which is as far as the source alone can establish. Note that max_gap_m spiking does NOT imply an ordering fault: 경의중앙선's 190,789 m comes from (1), while its ordering fault alone measures 58,874 m (1220 지평 -> 1251 서울역). 역번호 mixes 3- and 4-digit forms (64 rows are 3-digit), so ordering needs zero-padding. Eight 코레일 line groups are flagged order_verified=false (경의중앙선, 경부선, 경강선, 분당선, 수인선, 경인선, 동해선, 안산과천선). They share one cause: 역번호 is assigned in batches rather than in running order, and no column says where a batch belongs on the line. It surfaces three ways - stations of a later batch must be interleaved one by one into an earlier batch (경부선 1032 신길, 1714 독산, 1729 당정, 1749 서동탄, 1750 광명; also 경인선, 분당선); a whole batch must move as a unit (수인선 1755~1762 belongs between 1877 and 1878; 경의중앙선 merges the 중앙선 and 경의선 families); or the batch is a single station (경강선 1512 성남 stands 669 m from the 2nd station, 동해선 8015 부산원동 stands 868 m from the 7th, 안산과천선 1763 수리산). The last form has no gap in the numbering at all, so a block-structure scan cannot see it. The flag comes from inspecting every large adjacent-station gap, not from a distance threshold: 대경선 왜관–서대구 is a genuine 17.6 km gap while 동해선's 17.7 km is an ordering error, so the two cases overlap in magnitude and cannot be separated numerically.
